name: Ossuar the Bone Sun

abilities.name: Wounded Burst
abilities.description: The first time Ossuar has half its hit points or fewer in a fight, it releases a burst. Each creature in a 30-foot radius originating from Ossuar must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is blinded until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.description: If Ossuar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Spirit Jar
abilities.description: If destroyed, Ossuar reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its hit points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within Ossuar's lair.

abilities.name: Protective Magic (3/Day) (Reaction)
abilities.description: When Ossuar is hit by an attack roll, Ossuar casts *Shield* in response, gaining a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn, including against the triggering attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ossuar makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *Hold Person*.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the start of Ossuar's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
Ossuar casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19): - **At will:** *Detect Magic*, *Detect Thoughts*, *Dispel Magic*, *Fireball*, *Invisibility*, *Lightning Bolt*, *Mage Hand*, *Prestidigitation*
**2/day each:** *Animate Dead*, *Dimension Door*, *Plane Shift*
**1/day each:** *Chain Lightning*, *Finger of Death*, *Power Word Kill*, *Scrying*

legendary_actions.name: Deathly Teleport
legendary_actions.description: Ossuar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Disrupt Life
legendary_actions.description: Each creature that isn't an Undead in a 20-foot radius originating from Ossuar must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (9d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Frightening Gaze
legendary_actions.description: Ossuar casts *Fear*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Ossuar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
